title: Jim Morrison's birth chart
metaDescription: Jim Morrison's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 15.7° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 9.3° Taurus, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 15.7° into Sagittarius — the second decan, which the old scheme hands to Mars. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 0.9° Capricorn, Mars at 11.7° Gemini. Mercury in an earth sign reads as thought with its feet on the ground; Mars in an air sign reads as effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mercury to Venus, a sextile with 0.5° of slack. The scheme reads a sextile as a door left unlocked. Useful, and entirely dependent on someone walking through it. Behind it, Uranus sextile Pluto at 2.1°, and Uranus trine Neptune at 2.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags a single placement in this chart. The Moon in Taurus at 9.3° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives air 4, fire 3, earth 2, and mutable 4, fixed 3, cardinal 2 across the modes. Venus crossed from Libra into Scorpio during that day, so its sign is left open. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Mars, Saturn, Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Taurus for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.4° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 9.3°.
